systems.country_label: Local Addressing Database; Local Government GIS Addressing Database
systems.owner: Local Government Authorities, Area Councils and Municipal Councils
systems.tiers: Prescribed for every Local Government Area, to hold the addressing data it generates; none stated as built
State: collates, processes and stores addressing data generated within the State

systems.country_label: National Addressing Database; National Addressing GIS Unit
systems.owner: Ministry of Communications, which may assign hosting to Galaxy Backbone and NIPOST
systems.tiers: National: imports data from the State units; to be accessible through the National Bureau of Statistics portal

systems.owner: NIPOST, with backup hosted by Galaxy Backbone or another host

note: A standard of July 2017 prescribing what local governments shall do in street naming and addressing data. It lists broadband connectivity among the components of the addressing database without saying at which tier, states no local government office as connected, and says Nigeria then lacked a national addressing data infrastructure.
